summary: Create a markup on a proposal
description:
Returns 201 with the created markup.
An ITERATIVE markup always compounds all preceding markups; compound_all is set implicitly and
compound_with is not allowed. Only one ITERATIVE markup can exist per proposal, and it must be POST_TAX.
LEGACY_OVERHEAD and LEGACY_DISCOUNT must be PRE_TAX; creating one re-enables and updates the existing
disabled legacy markup when present. Creating a LEGACY_OVERHEAD sets an existing LEGACY_DISCOUNT's
compound_with to the overhead, and vice versa. Only markups from the same stage, except
ITERATIVE, can be referenced in compound_with.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

data.description: Represents a markup (adjustment) applied to a proposal.

id.description: The unique identifier of the markup. Returned by GET Estimate Summary in markups; use as markup_id on markup endpoints.

name.description: The display name of the markup.

value.description: The numeric value of the markup (percentage or lump sum amount).

value_type.description: The type of the markup value.

stage.description: The calculation stage of the markup.

compound_all.description: Whether this markup compounds with all preceding markups in the same stage.

compound_with.description: The IDs of specific markups this markup compounds with.

tax_mapping.description: The tax mapping category for this markup.

application_criteria.description: The flat list of conditions controlling which line items this markup applies to. Conditions are combined with logical AND.

items.description: A single application-criteria condition. Multiple conditions on a markup are combined with logical AND.

schema.description: Payload for creating a markup on a proposal.

name.description: The display name of the markup. Required. Must be unique among the proposal's markups (case-insensitive).

value.description: The numeric value of the markup (percentage or lump sum amount). Required.

value_type.description: The type of the markup value. Required.

stage.description: The calculation stage of the markup. Required. ITERATIVE markups require POST_TAX; LEGACY_OVERHEAD and LEGACY_DISCOUNT require PRE_TAX.

compound_all.description: Whether this markup compounds with all preceding markups in the same stage. Always set for ITERATIVE markups. Cannot be combined with compound_with.

compound_with.description: The IDs of existing markups this markup compounds with. Only markups from the same stage, except ITERATIVE, can be referenced.

tax_mapping.description: The cost category used in a markup application criteria filter.

application_criteria.description: The flat list of conditions controlling which line items this markup applies to. Conditions are combined with logical AND.

items.description: A single application-criteria condition. Multiple conditions on a markup are combined with logical AND.

operator.description: Whether this condition includes or excludes matching items.

line_item_group_id.description: Line item group IDs to match.
